issues.description: Security vulnerability: test_another_student_cannot_fetch_my_reply_audio fails with 'assert 200 == 403'. The endpoint returns 200 OK when it should deny access with 403 Forbidden, allowing cross-student audio fetching.
issues.suggestion: Fix the authorization check in the audio fetch endpoint to validate that the requesting student matches the audio owner. Add proper student_id validation before returning audio chunks.

issues.description: Missing mp3 format support: test_recordings_in_supported_formats_are_accepted_regardless_of_codec_annotations[mp3] fails with 'assert 415 == 200'. Mp3 recordings are rejected when they should be accepted.
issues.suggestion: Add mp3 to the list of supported audio formats in the voice endpoint. Ensure the content-type validation accepts audio/mpeg and audio/mp3 MIME types.

issues.description: ChunkStore expiry implementation bug: test_a_reply_audio_reference_fetched_promptly_succeeds_but_an_expired_one_is_gone fails with 'AttributeError: ChunkStore object has no attribute _chunks'.
issues.suggestion: Fix the ChunkStore implementation. The test code appears to access a private _chunks attribute that doesn't exist. Either add the _chunks attribute to ChunkStore or refactor the expiry test to use the public API.

issues.description: Lint/format checks not run: AC-004 requires all modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors, but the Player did not run these checks.
issues.suggestion: Run the project's lint/format checks on features/voice-server-module/test_voice_server_module.py and fix any violations. Typically this would be 'uv run ruff check' and 'uv run ruff format --check' or similar.

criteria_verification.notes: BDD authoring sweep shows 29 of 32 scenarios passing (90.6%). 3 test failures remain: (1) mp3 format returns 415 instead of 200, (2) audio expiry test has AttributeError on ChunkStore._chunks, (3) cross-student fetch security test returns 200 instead of 403 (security vulnerability). Criterion requires all wired scenarios to pass.

Hermetic testing confirmed by evidence bundle. All tests use TestClient + MockAudioTransport with no external network calls. Mock transport intercepts all audio service requests. No GB10 reachability required.

Orchestrator's runtime_parity check independently verified full repo suite passes: 'uv run pytest tests/unit -x -q' returned exit code 0 with 1216 passed, 3 skipped. Despite Player marking this uncertain, the evidence confirms the criterion is met.

Player marked this as uncertain and did not run lint/format checks. Evidence bundle confirms no validation was performed. Cannot verify that modified files pass project linting standards without executing the checks.

rationale: The Player delivered substantial progress with 90.6% test pass rate and hermetic testing, achieving 2 of 4 acceptance criteria (AC-002, AC-003). However, 3 test failures block approval: a critical security vulnerability allowing cross-student audio access, missing mp3 format support, and a ChunkStore implementation bug. Additionally, AC-004 (lint/format checks) was not validated. The security issue is particularly critical as it violates isolation between students.
